tools.name: build_indexnow_payload
tools.description: Validates a key and URL list against the IndexNow spec and returns the exact JSON POST body, the endpoint, a ready-to-run curl command, and the reason for every URL it dropped. Enforces the same-host rule, the 10000-URL batch limit, https/http consistency, fragment stripping and de-duplication.

tools.name: validate_indexnow_key
tools.description: Checks an IndexNow key against the protocol schema (length, character set) and, given a host, returns the exact URL the key file must be served from, the exact contents it must have, and the curl command to verify it. Most 403 rejections are a key file that returns an HTML 404 page with a 200 status

tools.name: diff_sitemaps
tools.description: Parses two sitemap documents (urlset XML, sitemapindex XML, or a newline-delimited URL list) and reports added, removed and lastmod-changed URLs. Returns only the URLs worth submitting to IndexNow. Pass a key to also get the finished, validated POST body.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_indexnow_payload, diff_sitemaps · Private data: validate_indexnow_key, diff_sitemaps · Public sink: build_indexnow_payload, diff_sitemaps · Destructive: build_indexnow_payload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_indexnow_payload, diff_sitemaps · Private data: validate_indexnow_key, diff_sitemaps · Public sink: build_indexnow_payload, diff_sitemaps · Destructive: build_indexnow_payload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
